correctness.rationale: The reset rule gives the periodic gate exactly: s_phi(t)=exp[-beta((t+phi) mod T)]. Substitution of the printed one-branch expression into the interaction integral factors all phase dependence as exp(-beta phi), so its odd part is proportional to sinh(beta phi), which is nonperiodic and generically lacks the half-period anti-phase zero. The contradiction is exact and does not rely on simulation.
